scope: Headless Chrome, 1100x900, production builds, alternating variants, no CPU throttling. All variants use smoothStreaming=true and parseCoalesceMs=0. Off is fade=false and includes its existing pacing/DOM optimizations. Drain is current source with only final flush, final fade settlement and final enter-transition suppression disabled at build time. Timings include trace and identical RAF/DOM sampling overhead. Paint is renderer main-thread paint recording; RasterTask is renderer raster CPU, not GPU time. Durations overlap and must not be summed. Missing CompositeLayers/RasterTask events do not imply zero GPU cost.
